question: Where does the speaker claim to abide in relation to all beings?
premises: The speaker refers to all beings.
The speaker states an abiding presence.
The locus is the supreme thousand-petalled lotus.
inference: The speaker abides in the supreme thousand-petalled lotus as a locus relating to all.
uncertainties: sarveṣāṃ may qualify beings or another implied referent
plain_english: Indeed, I abide in the supreme thousand-petalled lotus of all.
